mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate at 0.06% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates and boosts valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 50% or less of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 265.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 50% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL > 265.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low FEDFUNDS (below 0.5%) and high CPIAUCSL (above 265.0) signals a 'stagflation' regime where policy constraints reduce equity returns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 50% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 265.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), economic weakness reduces corporate earnings growth potential, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 50% or more of instances where UNRATE > 5.5 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0, it signals weakening consumer demand and reduced corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 50% or more of instances where HOUST < 1500.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 99.0, it indicates manufacturing contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 50% or more of instances where INDPRO < 99.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low HOUST (below 1500.0) and low RSAFS (below 600000.0) signals broad demand weakness in housing and consumer sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 50% or more of instances where HOUST < 1500.0 AND RSAFS < 600000.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) fall below 144000.0, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 50% or more of instances where PAYEMS < 144000.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).
